purpose: Put one action after completion of another.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
I eat after washing my hands.
I will call after work finishes.
I have walked every day since coming to Japan.
restrictions: The first action establishes the starting point for the next.
mistake: This から follows て-form; it is not the same formation as a reason clause.

segments.role: Put one action after completion of another. て-form + から + following action.

examples.translation: I eat after washing my hands.
